description: Search Oklahoma oil & gas wells by county, operator, API number, and/or well type using the Oklahoma Corporation Commission (OCC) RBDMS well database (keyless public record). Unlike a pure map layer, this returns the OPERATOR, well status, well type (OIL/GAS/DRY/etc.), well name, county, and location for each match, plus the total matching count and a by-operator/by-type breakdown. Use it for 'who operates wells in county X', 'how many wells does operator Y have', or an operator's well portfolio. Oklahoma covers the Anadarko Basin / SCOOP / STACK plays. At least one of county, operator, or api is recommended to narrow the search.

api.description: API well number (digits; non-digits are ignored).

limit.description: Max well records to return (default 25, max 100). The total matching count is always reported.

operator.description: Operator name or fragment (e.g. 'Chesapeake', 'Devon'). Substring, case-insensitive.

well_type.description: Filter by well type: OIL, GAS, DRY, SWD (saltwater disposal), etc.

name: ok_wells_search
